central_bank_calendars.note: Meeting dates are parsed from each bank's official schedule page; decision times are configured standard announcement times (the pages list dates only). Stored as date/event facts with attribution, never page text.

ecb.time_basis: ECB decision 14:15 CET (Frankfurt time; ECB press release of 27 June 2022, effective 21 July 2022); the page lists dates only
ecb.press_conference_time_basis: ECB press conference 14:45 CET (Frankfurt time; ECB press release of 27 June 2022); sub-event of the decision
ecb.terms: Free reuse if reproduced accurately with the ECB cited as source (ECB disclaimer page).

boe.time_basis: BoE standard MPC announcement time 12:00 UK time (configured; the page lists dates only)
boe.terms: Site resources for personal or internal non-commercial use only (bankofengland.co.uk/legal); store dates as facts, do not republish page text.

boj.time_basis: approximate: the BoJ releases its statement when the meeting ends (no fixed time); 12:00 JST is a configured placeholder
boj.note_session: Date-only decision anchored to the Tokyo business day of the last meeting day (docs/EVENT_AWARENESS.md §8): phases follow that day, never the 12:00 placeholder.
boj.terms: Reproduction allowed with explicit credit to the Bank of Japan, not for commercial purposes (boj.or.jp/en/about/copyright.htm).

finnhub.note: Finnhub free plan: personal use only, no redistribution (finnhub.io/terms-of-service). /quote is documented real-time for US stocks; index levels are premium, so only ETF proxies are shown and never mapped onto index symbols.
finnhub.session_basis: market state from backend.sessions (market_sessions.asset_classes.equity = XNYS calendar)

delay_labels.stale_open: STALE: no trade for {minutes} min while the market is open (last trade {as_of})
delay_labels.unknown_session: last trade {as_of} (market session unknown; not live)

earnings.note: GET /calendar/earnings (free plan: upcoming dates plus 1 month of history), one query per tracked equity: an all-symbol query is cut at 1500 rows and silently drops symbols. Calls share the 60/min guard with quotes.
earnings.estimate_note: Finnhub's estimates include its own proprietary estimates; not Street consensus
earnings.note_sessions: session is the anchor the event engine uses for a date-only row (docs/EVENT_AWARENESS.md §8): BMO = before the 09:30 ET open, AMC = after the 16:00 ET close; during-hours rows carry no session field and are matched by their time_basis to 09:30-16:00 ET (event_risk.phases.date_only_sessions); unknown sessions fall back to the whole New York day.

bmo.time_basis: before the US open (Finnhub gives the session only; exact time not published)

amc.time_basis: after the US close (Finnhub gives the session only; exact time not published)

dmh.time_basis: during US market hours (Finnhub gives the session only; exact time not published)

earnings.note_estimates: Estimates use the consensus shape of docs/EVENT_AWARENESS.md §8 under the row's `estimates` ({label: estimate_label, values: [{name, value, unit}], note}); the source is the row's consensus_source and `consensus` stays empty. The flat keys (eps, revenue) stay beside `values` for readers of the earlier shape. Never labelled 'Consensus'.
